title: Local Store, Online Overnight
summary: A complete online store for a neighborhood retailer — product catalog, WhatsApp ordering, and festival offer banners.
disclosure: Selected sample — capability example, not a client engagement.
body: This sample shows how a neighborhood retailer could bring its shelves online, with a browsable product catalog paired with simple WhatsApp ordering and eye-catching festival offer banners.
As an E-commerce Website example, it demonstrates catalog layout, chat-based ordering flow, and promotional banner placement a small shop could reuse.
